summary: Advanced Energy Industries filed an 8-K announcing a proposed private offering of $1 billion aggregate principal amount of Convertible Senior Notes due 2031, with an option for initial purchasers to buy an additional $150 million. The company plans to use a portion of the net proceeds to pay for capped call transactions and to exchange a portion of the notes for shares of common stock and cash in exchange for certain of its existing 2.50% Senior Convertible Notes due 2028. Remaining proceeds will be used for general corporate purposes, including potential retirement of the remaining 2028 notes outside the exchange. This is a routine capital markets transaction, not a special situation.
